summary: Updated list_all to /v2 paths, limit/cursor pagination (filters on first request only, limit every request, stops at has_more false), data key, and 429/503 retry (max 4 attempts, Retry-After seconds/date, defaults 1s/2s via sleep/now). Docs disagree on max limit (pagination page 500 vs changelog 200); I used 500 per the pagination page.
